thread:
maya: Heads up — praxis-mini (q6 quant) bring-up failing our multilang smoke for some mixed-orientation inputs. Vertical Japanese with inline Arabic is flipping brackets and reversing numerals in the output. Anyone?
liang: Can you paste a tiny repro and the command you ran?
maya: Repro attached inline. Ran local smoke with the quant build on CPU fallback. Command:
```
./bench/eval_local --model=repo/praxis-mini-q6:latest --suite=multiorient_smoke --input=tests/mix_jp_ar.json --batch=1
```
Input snippet:
```
「歌詞（مرحبا ١٢٣）
ふりがな：ふりがな」
```
Observed output snippet:
```
(مرحبا ٣٢١）歌詞）
ふりがな: ふりがな
```
Notice the Arabic numerals are mirrored and the Japanese closing bracket moved after the Arabic segment.
sofia: ugh. metrics show BLEU baseline (fp16) 24.3 -> praxis-mini-q6 17.9 on this mini-suite. chrF -5.8. Tokenization mismatch count +48 across 200 samples, mostly when AR segments are embedded inside JP brackets.
liang: Sounds like a detokenization/orientation issue on the quant path. Is this limited to q6 or also in q8/q4? maya: quick checks: q8_fp16 fallback = fine, q4 shows the same but weaker. q6 strong repro. Also only on the CPU fallback path; GPU run doesn't show it (haven't fully bisected yet).
eval-bot: Auto-report: failure-id=ml-smoke-3032109999-ix; model-sha=ac3d9f2; repo=infra/models/praxis-mini; kernel-path=cpu_fallback_v2
maya: config used for the run (excerpt):
```
quant:
  type: q6_dynamic
  per_channel: true
runtime:
  kernel_selector: auto
  fallback: cpu_v2
tokenizer:
  version: token-stub-v1
```
sofia: note token-stub-v1 is the older detokenizer used in the quant packaging. We recently shipped token-stub-v2 in the non-quant path which has bidi-aware joiners. Could be related.
liang: I'll try swapping the detok to token-stub-v2 on the q6 build and re-run the mini-suite. If repro goes away, we can decide fix vs. bundled fallback change.
maya: uploading logs to s3: s3://redwood-triage/3032109999/artifacts.tar.gz
infra-bot: Canary config note: disabled auto-upgrade for praxis-mini-q6 in asia-1 until triage complete. (reason: locale regressions)
liang: quick profiling shows an unexpected branch in the cpu_fallback_v2 detok code: bidi_normalize() gets skipped when a mixed-script span length < 8. That matches many of our short-furigana+arabic snippets.
sofia: if that condition is wrong we might be dropping mirror flags and then the detok reordering is applied incorrectly. Could also be tokenizer producing a ZWJ/ZWSP difference after quant packing.
maya: agreed. immediate mitigation: pin praxis-mini non-quant (fp16) for any customer routes with multiorient locales until we have a fix. I'll open a ticket with triage notes.
liang: assigning to myself for a bisect. Plan: (1) run q6 with token-stub-v2; (2) if still repro, bisect cpu_fallback_v2 kernel branch; (3) create small unit test for mixed JP+AR bracket/number cases.
sofia: add an eval that checks numeric orientation and bracket attachment to the multiorient_smoke suite. We need it as a CI gate for quant bringups.
maya: created issue RI-1427 and linked logs. tagging @sofia in the issue for test updates.
liang: will update here with a repro patch or bisect result by EOD PST.
sofia: :) thanks. please add the failing sample to the test corpus so we don't regress again.
maya: done — sample id mmix-3032109999 added to tests/mix_corpus.json
infra-bot: rollback plan in case of customer hit: route affected requests to praxis-mini-fp16 and notify on-call. Canary rollback trigger: >2 customer errors/min or BLEU delta >4 on canary suite.
maya: cool. marking this thread resolved-for-now. reactions: :mag_right: :exclamation:
liang: quick note — if anyone wants to help with the bisect ping me, I might need a patch for the tokenizer packing tool.
sofia: will help with adding the unit test. thanks team.
